operating_notes.text: Loans (net of provision) stood at ₹3,924.20 Cr at 31 March 2026 against ₹2,237.06 Cr a year earlier.
Gross and net NPA were NIL at 31 March 2026; CRAR was 36.67% and debt-equity 1.85.
The company acquired ₹42 Cr of loans through assignment during Q4FY26 with 13% retention of beneficial economic interest.
The company incorporated two wholly owned subsidiaries during the quarter: SG Insurance Brokers Limited and SG Alternative Investment Fund Limited.
Loan book reached an all-time high of ₹5,694 Cr as of September 30, 2026.
Collection efficiency remains high at 99.5% with nil 60+ DPD.
